title: Search Jezero for biosignatures
description: En el lecho seco de un lago antiguo hay arcilla y capas. Mira dos puntos. Eso no demuestra que hubo vida.
science: Una biosignatura es una pista que podría venir de vida, o de otra cosa. Hay que contrastarla en la Tierra. Lugar real: Cráter Jezero, 18,41° N, 77,69° E (Mars Trek).
done: No hay prueba de vida. Hay una posible biosignatura, o un falso positivo, que habría que contrastar en la Tierra.

objectives.label: Escanea las capas del sedimento
objectives.note: No hay prueba de vida. Puede ser una biosignatura o un falso positivo.
objectives.note_en: There is no proof of life. It may be a biosignature or a false positive.

description_en: In the dry bed of an ancient lake there is clay and layers. Look at two spots. That does not prove there was life.
science_en: A biosignature is a clue that could come from life, or from something else. It has to be checked on Earth. Real place: Jezero Crater, 18.41° N, 77.69° E (Mars Trek).
done_en: There is no proof of life. There is a possible biosignature, or a false positive, that would have to be checked on Earth.
